NewsArticle.Title: Political Uniforms
NewsArticle.Content:
Political uniforms become more secure. They may not be dropped or traded or deposited.
Be sure to take possession of your political uniform, or else it will be impossible to reclaim until you enter your next political term. The current Aisling will have possession, although he or she cannot wear it and it will be taken from when the Aisling passes through a village threshold.
